newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends up on tightish supply, technicals.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends up on tightish supply, technicals.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures ended firmer on Thursday amid tightish supply and supportive technicals, traders said.
June gas oil settled $1.25 higher at $172.00 a tonne, while June Brent was trading 11 cents off at $19.40 a barrel at 1642 GMT.
Traders attributed gas oil's strength to fairly tight physical supply as well as supportive technical formations on the charts.
"We saw a bit of profit-taking towards the close," said one trader. June had been as high as $173.25 a tonne.

"But it's not that freely available on the physical side and technically the market is looking good, so every time it falls below certain levels we see the technical players coming in," the trader said.
June Brent continued its rangebound, sideways path, never quite managing to push up into positive territory.

Traders attributed Brent's losses to crude run cuts at Texaco's Nerefco refinery in Rotterdam, virtually unchanged June Brent loading programmes and the continued influence of Tuesday's bearish American Petroleum Institute (API) data.
Many traders maintained, however, that a recovery was still possible, given the strong gains on Monday. -- Melanie Goodfellow, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714
